# Overview
## Row {height=35%}
Welcome to my ECON 5371 Time Series Analysis dashboard.

This project examines U.S. unemployment rates for four age groups:

- Ages 16–19
- Ages 20–24
- Ages 25–34
- Ages 55+

The analysis uses monthly unemployment data from FRED and ARIMA models to examine historical trends and forecast future unemployment rates.

```{python}
#| include: false

from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

DATA_PATH = Path("../data/clean/unemployment_clean.csv")

df = pd.read_csv(DATA_PATH)

print("Data loaded successfully!")
print("Rows:", len(df))
```

# Historical Unemployment Trends

```{python}
#| title: "U.S. Unemployment Rates by Age Group"
#| echo: false

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 5))

for group, data in df.groupby("age_group"):
    data = data.sort_values("observation_date")
    ax.plot(
        pd.to_datetime(data["observation_date"]),
        data["unemployment_rate"],
        label=f"Ages {group}"
    )

ax.set_title("U.S. Unemployment Rates by Age Group")
ax.set_xlabel("Year")
ax.set_ylabel("Unemployment Rate (%)")
ax.legend(title="Age Group")
ax.grid(alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
#| title: "Monthly Changes in Unemployment Rates by Age Group"
#| echo: false

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 5))

for group, data in df.groupby("age_group"):
    data = data.sort_values("observation_date").copy()
    data["observation_date"] = pd.to_datetime(data["observation_date"])
    data = data.set_index("observation_date")

    monthly_rates = data["unemployment_rate"].asfreq("MS")
    monthly_changes = monthly_rates.diff()

    ax.plot(
        monthly_changes.index,
        monthly_changes,
        label=f"Ages {group}"
    )

ax.set_title("Monthly Changes in Unemployment Rates by Age Group")
ax.set_xlabel("Year")
ax.set_ylabel("Monthly Change (Percentage Points)")
ax.legend(title="Age Group")
ax.grid(alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

# ARIMA Forecasts

```{python}
#| title: "12-Month Unemployment Forecast: Ages 16–19"
#| echo: false

forecast = pd.read_csv(
    "../output/unemployment_forecast_16_19.csv",
    index_col=0
)

forecast.index = pd.to_datetime(forecast.index)

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 5))

ax.plot(
    forecast.index,
    forecast["Forecast"],
    label="ARIMA Forecast",
    color="blue",
    linewidth=2
)
ax.fill_between(
      forecast.index,
    forecast["Lower CI"],
    forecast["Upper CI"],
    color="blue",
    alpha=0.2,
    label="95% Confidence Interval"
)
ax.set_title("12-Month Unemployment Forecast: Ages 16–19")
ax.set_xlabel("Month")
ax.set_ylabel("Unemployment Rate (%)")
ax.legend()
ax.grid(alpha=0.3)

ax.tick_params(axis="x", labelrotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
